_note: IAM job roles the interview prep targets. Descriptions are this project's own summary of common job postings, not any employer's wording.

roles.name: IAM Analyst / Identity Operations
roles.what_you_do: Work the access queue: create, change and remove accounts, approve or route access requests, reset MFA, run access reviews and answer audit evidence requests.
certs: Microsoft SC-300 or Okta Certified Professional

roles.name: Microsoft Entra / Identity Administrator
roles.what_you_do: Run Microsoft Entra ID: Conditional Access, authentication methods, Privileged Identity Management, hybrid sync, guests, app registrations and access reviews.

roles.name: Okta Administrator
roles.what_you_do: Run Okta: users, groups and group rules, app integrations with SAML/OIDC and provisioning, sign-on policies, authenticators, admin roles and System Log investigations.

roles.name: IGA / SailPoint Engineer
roles.what_you_do: Build identity governance in SailPoint Identity Security Cloud: onboard sources, map identity attributes with transforms, design lifecycle states, roles and access profiles, certifications, SoD policies and workflows.

roles.name: IAM Engineer (senior track)
roles.what_you_do: Design the identity platform: federation and SSO patterns, privileged access, non-human identities, zero trust policy, automation and the IAM roadmap.
